title: clampSeverity silently ignores an unrecognised floor or ceiling, so a misconfigured degraded lens runs uncapped while every artifact says otherwise
found_by: self-review; recorded in the decisions.mjs header as the founding defect of the module
notes: The original shipped exactly this: a guard of the form `if (RUNGS.includes(ceiling))` fell through when a VERDICT ('RISK') was passed to the severity parameter, and the cap quietly did nothing. The tell: spawn-node passes verdict ceilings and severity ceilings through nearby call paths, and a validator that skips instead of throwing produces the paperwork of a guarantee without the guarantee. v2 (2026-09-01): the patch now also strips the module-header and docstring prose narrating the historical fix. The v1 patch left them, and the 2026-09-01T19-15 catch cited the docstring contradiction directly — an ASSISTED catch measuring doc-vs-code matching, not pre-discovery detection.
